content.text: “Ne kewed yaambed mene kibikee yimbed dabab yemoon bangkawiwen.” andime.
Kedi, kekane yedmime, “Ne kewed yaambed mene kibikee yimbed dabab yemoon bangkawiwen,
kumban yi kuu ne yaa ma nangme burudande dorindo.
Yimbed ne angkurom yaa kuu nong yikyikiibbed wangkanabiwen kumbed
koodem areb kuburu doboob yemooniib keraan.
kedi, yembed kuye arewa kamenabidanbed ne nen yerengkiwen ye nong kuu nare burudande obon kawoon.” andime.
Kaneya yi kuu Saiyon yaa arud wandembirimaib kuu,
yi korem yaa karak kondene yenbandoko ikakman winime.
Kwane yi kuu kereek ambib animari dembekore
Yi kuu wande bi ye karubbed kuyaa yob ma wedmindo kuye kereek areb kerime,
kwane yi kuu wiit yob andedmi ye karubbed kuyaambed ma andedmindo kuye kereek areb kerime.
Yi yaa dewenebe burudandandamiibdan kuu kekane yedmaib,
“Yariman ye amun kerundi kuu yiib ari kowok,
kwane Yariman yaningko yaambed yiib yaa amun kerunduub kii.” andaib.
